recognize_zh: CD7/CD34 流式散佈圖中，紅色芽細胞族群位於上方，CD34 異常強陽性且帶有弱 CD7，紫色正常 T 細胞為 CD7+CD34−，棕色成熟嗜中性球與單核球兩者皆陰性；骨髓系芽細胞異常表現 CD7 且 CD34 偏亮，是 TAM／唐氏症相關芽細胞常見的表型。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot: CD7-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD34-PC7 (y-axis) with quadrant gates
Red blast population: bright CD34 with dim CD7, spanning into the CD34+CD7+ quadrant
Purple normal T cells: CD7-positive (brighter than blasts) and CD34-negative
Brown mature neutrophils and monocytes: CD34-negative and CD7-negative (lower-left quadrant)
Blast CD7 intensity is clearly lower than that of normal T cells, confirming dim aberrant expression
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD7 versus CD34 shows a large blast population (red) with abnormally bright CD34 and dim, aberrant CD7 expression. Normal T cells (purple) express brighter CD7 without CD34, and mature neutrophils and monocytes (brown) are negative for both, serving as internal controls. Together with CD33 and CD117 co-expression on the blasts, this aberrant myeloid blast phenotype in a neonate with Down syndrome is consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; CD7 expression alone does not indicate T lineage.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Shares the CD34+CD7+ myeloid/megakaryoblastic phenotype and is separated clinically by age, persistence and additional mutations rather than by flow cytometry.
ETP-ALL is CD7+CD34+ but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks the megakaryocytic markers (CD41/CD61) typical of TAM blasts.
Requires bright cytoplasmic CD3 on the blasts, whereas dim CD7 on myeloid blasts is a common non-lineage-defining aberrancy.
